newsitem.title: FRANCE: Elf rises on positive Merrill Lynch study.
newsitem.headline: Elf rises on positive Merrill Lynch study.

text.p: Shares in Elf Aquitaine were up more than three percent on Wednesday, bolstered by a study by Merrill Lynch in which the U.S. investment firm said it preferred Elf to Total or Italy's ENI, brokers said.
Elf shares were 3.1 percent higher at 565 francs at 1425 GMT, while Total shares were up 1.3 percent at 475.70 francs.

"Merrill Lynch, which held a presentation yesterday in Zurich, considers Elf a better buy than Total. It reiterated its positive opinion on the share," a trader said. "But everyone's bullish on Elf now."
Another trader said Elf was benefiting from a series of positive brokerage reports and a strong dollar.
